display_title: I Possessed a Body and Became an Urban Legend
description:
The problem is that I woke up inside a coffin - on the day of the original owner’s funeral, no less. To make matters worse, I’ve read so many web novels that I can’t even tell which story I’ve fallen into. Based on my cold-hearted family and the way the maids tremble at the sight of me, it’s clear: I’ve possessed the body of a villainess. Alright. I’ll just have to use my years of experience reading romance-fantasy to escape this “villainess” trope! That was the plan, until I discovered a strange crest. 

“What is this?”

 [How to Summon □□] 

Is this a summoning circle for a spirit or a dragon? Perfect. A villainess needs at least one way to defend herself. 

“Meow.” 

But instead of a spirit or a dragon, why have I been chosen by a three-eyed, leopard-print ginger cat? Well, it’s cute, so I guess it doesn’t matter!
